problem.title: What makes property management more complex than it should be
problem.subtitle: Most owners and operators run on the same broken playbook.

pains.title: Staff costs eat your margins
pains.desc: Receptionists, cleaners, maintenance — the list never ends. You can't scale without hiring more. And labor is expensive.

pains.title: Operational chaos
pains.desc: Last-minute bookings, late check-ins, guest complaints. Everything feels urgent. You're always on call.

pains.title: OTA dependency
pains.desc: 15–30% commissions. Your brand buried in their search. You play by their rules. They own your distribution.

pains.title: Lack of control
pains.desc: You rely on staff to show up. On OTAs to send guests. On spreadsheets to track it all. One person quits and everything breaks.

solution.title: One operating system for your property.
solution.desc: ASI connects smart locks, cleaning, payments, and communication in one place. You configure once. It runs.
solution.highlight: Guests check in with a code. Messages are automated. Cleaning is scheduled. Payments are collected. You get a dashboard.

platformCapabilities.title: Key capabilities of the ASI platform
platformCapabilities.subtitle: A full automation platform, not just a channel manager — from distribution and pricing to communication and financial control.

modules.title: Channel and OTA distribution management
intro: ASI can automatically distribute property information and media across multiple sales channels.
bullets: Integrate with existing channel managers and OTA platforms
modules.note: The system includes its own channel manager, so third-party channel managers may be optional.

modules.title: Intelligent dynamic pricing engine
intro: ASI uses dynamic pricing algorithms that analyze market conditions in real time.
Unlike traditional systems based mainly on historical ADR data, the platform evaluates many more factors.
modules.note: This approach enables pricing decisions that often exceed the accuracy of traditional manual revenue management.

modules.title: Demand and occupancy strategy
intro: ASI helps build occupancy strategy based on target audience and market factors.
modules.note: The goal is to achieve the most stable and efficient occupancy level for the property.

modules.title: Location and property potential analysis
intro: ASI can analyze location appeal in much greater depth than typical real estate yield calculators.
bullets: Recommend how to package the property

modules.title: Autonomous property management
intro: In full configuration the system can perform most operational tasks automatically.
Typically only housekeeping and technical staff (home master) are required. ASI handles most operational processes.

modules.title: Intelligent communication system
intro: The ASI communication module is designed for full interaction with guests and staff.
The system imitates natural human dialogue rather than acting as a simple auto-reply bot.
modules.note: The system can identify whether the contact has a valid reservation and restrict access to sensitive information.

modules.title: Financial control and safety
intro: ASI has no access to user funds.
modules.note: Even in autopilot mode the owner retains full control. Users can define the level of automation and when the system must hand decisions back to the owner.

architecture.title: ASI Architecture
architecture.subtitle: ASI operates on top of your existing infrastructure and enhances it.
architecture.footer: At the initial stage, ASI integrates with your channel manager. As you scale, operational dependency on third-party systems can be optimized.

economicImpact.title: Economic impact of automation
economicImpact.intro1: ASI can significantly reduce operational costs and simplify property management.
economicImpact.intro2: In many cases, managing short-term rentals requires dedicated staff: an administrator, booking manager or property manager.
economicImpact.intro3: ASI automates most of these tasks.
economicImpact.exampleText: Managing around 5 properties in major cities typically requires:
economicImpact.examplePayroll: Payroll can be around 100,000–120,000 RUB per month or more.
economicImpact.automationText1: With ASI, a large part of operational processes is automated.
economicImpact.automationText2: Property management can be reduced to system oversight and coordinating service staff.
economicImpact.note: ASI does not replace the business owner. It automates operations and helps make better management decisions.

whyStartNow.title: Why many property owners start automating now
whyStartNow.intro1: The short-term rental market is becoming more competitive.
whyStartNow.intro2: Property management requires more time, attention and data analysis than ever.
whyStartNow.intro3: Those who automate earlier gain an advantage in efficiency and decision speed.
whyStartNow.final: That is why many owners start implementing automation now — to build a management system and prepare for scaling.
